subject.title: fix(xai): Grok subscription inference fails with HTTP 426 on every request

question: Should a built-in xAI OAuth compatibility header be emitted only for the canonical Grok OAuth proxy, or should it intentionally follow every existing `models.providers.xai.baseUrl` override?
rationale: Both choices are viable for reverse proxies, but the latter changes an existing documented custom-endpoint contract and cannot safely be selected by automated review.

options.title: Preserve custom endpoint behavior
options.body: Emit `x-grok-client-version` only for the canonical Grok OAuth proxy and add coverage proving a custom xAI base URL remains header-free by default.

options.title: Adopt header propagation
options.body: Allow the header to follow custom xAI base URLs, document the new outbound protocol behavior, and accept that strict proxies must tolerate it.

recommendation.title: Preserve custom endpoint behavior
recommendation.body: Emit `x-grok-client-version` only for the canonical Grok OAuth proxy and add coverage proving a custom xAI base URL remains header-free by default.

likelyOwner.reason: The xAI extension’s prior merged ownership was not available in the supplied context; resolve the current area owner before choosing the compatibility contract.
